title: Understanding the Variance of the Estimator
text: To find the variance of the estimator \( \hat{\delta} $$=$$ \bar{K} - \bar{D} \), we need to consider the properties of variance for independent random variables.

title: Variance of a Difference
text: Recall that if \( X \) and \( Y \) are independent random variables, then \( $$Var(X-Y)$$ $$=$$ Var(X) + Var(Y) \).

title: Variance of Sample Means
text: The variance of a sample mean \( \bar{X} \) from a sample of size \( $$n$$ \) with variance \( \sigma**2 \) is \( \frac{\sigma**2}{n} \).

title: Applying the Variance Formula
text: Using the formula for the variance of a difference and the variance of sample means, compute \( Var(\hat{\delta}) \).
